## Review

Binding: PR 456, published and detached-tree head `bcddef5e9bfb84fc69bf6a11b3e5cb25ccddd794`, base `4cfa73320d8f9b7bc3ef2a2dfbc40f242e94d54c`, trusted published-main instructions `dfc0a5fb29c1e5db070538cd59bdbb90025f1fee`. This is an independent **bounded F1/F2 recheck**, not a fifth full proof review, a new proof budget, or a patch-identity carry. Four full review rounds (5148574797, 5151788131, 5155066497, 5235361314) and the adverse terminal review 5241348222 at `d9bd07927083965375696006dd7eb52a9dffcc33` remain in the record, unchanged. The actual correction from that terminal head is exactly one changed file, `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex` (23 additions, 11 deletions); no Lean statements, proofs, imports, paper mirrors, or other tracked files changed in this delta.

F1 resolved at `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1897-1933`. The auxiliary `thm:conditional-restricted-lines-consistency` takes the supplied projective point/paired-line families and their **unrestricted** evaluated consistency bound, with the same directed opposite placements, independently sampled X/Z line-point variables, both kinds and zero-based `Fin m` indices. Its **restricted** conclusion now uses `\widetilde D_{\mathrm v_1,i} \times \widetilde D_{\mathrm v_2,j}`. This matches `restricted_lines_consistency_bound` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines.lean:269-295`): its premise is `CombinedLinesWitness.consistent` on a product of seed-bearing `linePointDist`, and its conclusion is the same evaluated `consistencyDefect` on a product of seed-bearing `restrictedLinePointDist`, with universal `C=4` and the factor `m^2 deltaP`. `LineDesc.axis` contains the scalar seed (`Observables/LineDefs.lean:46-61`), so the corrected symbol, not the untilded source law, has the right sample domain. The added qualification explicitly disclaims source-measurement construction and source transport without factorization through the forgetful maps. Source `lem:qld-xz-lines-restricted` retains untilded laws and `\notready` (`ch15:1863-1895`); its paper equation is `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1061`, especially `eq:qld-xz-lines-restricted`.

F2 resolved at `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:2229-2275,2321-2340`. The X projection is the mixture of `(ellX,x)` from `\widetilde D_{v,i}` with independent `ellZ` from the line marginal of `\widetilde D_{v,j}`; the Z projection uses the line marginal of `\widetilde D_{v,i}` with `(ellZ,z)` from `\widetilde D_{v,j}`. `SubLineWitness.source_mixture` (`Combining/Witnesses.lean:231-238`) quantifies **one** probability distribution on `(LineKind,Fin m,Fin m)` and gives just these two separate marginal identities. The component laws at `Witnesses.lean:179-199` preserve the X/Z order, product independence within a component, and both axis seeds; `Lines/SubLineMixture.lean:107-119,172-211` supplies the common mixture law and its equal axis/diagonal branch weights. No joint conditional independence is claimed. The source marginal identities are stated as consequences after the componentwise forgetful maps, not as equality on the unforgotten sample carrier; `def:line-point-dist` (`ch13:163-203`) explains that the axis map forgets the seed and the diagonal map retains it. The existence lemma now explicitly refers to the seed-bearing marginals of the directly indexed witness. The paper's source `lem:qld-sublines` and its seed-indexed extended-line marginal (`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`) remain distinct and `\notready` at `ch15:1935-1990`; the cited dimension-divisibility transport is still open, not supplied by this correction.

Source/domain basis: `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:230-287` (`eq:cl-dlnf`, `lem:alnf`, `lem:dlnf`, `def:line-point-dist`) distinguishes the axis source line from the diagonal description carrying its seed. Chapter 13's refined/source maps and chapter 15's `def:ith-restricted-line` (`ch15:1793-1821`) distinguish the tilded restrictions from their source push-forwards and translate the paper's one-based index to `Fin m`. The revised paragraphs do not add hypotheses to a source-labelled theorem or mark either source lemma proved. The correction changes no `\lean{}` link or label and creates no duplicate of the five affected nodes. Code verdict: APPROVED for this bounded unchanged-code delta; prose and statement-equivalence verdict: APPROVED for F1/F2. No new finding in the correction.

Checks: read the full 23+/11- patch and complete affected nodes, the paper passages above, the restricted-consistency signature, `CombinedLinesWitness.consistent`, `SubLineWitness.source_mixture`, both component distributions and the sub-line mixture proof; checked affected label/link occurrences; `git diff --name-status` and `git diff --check d9bd0792..bcddef5e` confirmed the one-file scope and no whitespace errors. PRIMARY `gh_common.py pr-view 456` confirmed open exact head; `latest-statuses bcddef5e...` confirmed nine successful local-ci contexts (summary 357 seconds, statement-origin normally skipped). Supplied rooted axiom audit: PASS 1621, FAIL 0, four statement-only warnings, no proof-level `sorryAx`. Detached worktree `git status --short --branch` printed only `## HEAD (no branch)` and `git diff --exit-code` passed. No full CI/build, Lean type-check, blueprint render, fresh axiom audit, or renewed review of unchanged proof bodies was performed here; those are prior exact-head CI/rooted-audit evidence, not independently rerun tests. No tracked edit, status, metadata, or issue was written.

VERDICT: APPROVED

body:
### Motivation

Complete the documentation of the line-parameter resampling results tracked
by #452. The corresponding Lean proofs are now present on main; the remaining
contribution records their statements and the relation between seed-bearing
and marginal sampling laws in the blueprint.

### Description

- Add the uniform-line resampling theorem and its axis, diagonal and mixed
  line-point corollaries in chapter 15, linked to the existing Lean results.
- State the seed-bearing laws and their forgetful maps in chapter 13, and
  retain the corresponding notation in the restricted-mixture statements.
- Update the mixed-resampling and sub-line-prefix citations. Reuse main's
  existing declarations and certification nodes after integration.
- Correct the conditional restricted-consistency and directly indexed sub-line
  statements to use the seed-bearing laws in their Lean declarations. Source
  laws require the stated forgetful maps; source measurement construction and
  factorization obligations remain explicit.

### Testing

- The domain correction at `bcddef5e9bfb84fc69bf6a11b3e5cb25ccddd794` passed
  blueprint rendering, strict sync, declaration resolution, citation checks
  and ordinary commit hooks. An initial sync failure came from a stale ignored
  generated declaration index; its normal refresh and strict rerun passed.
- Guarded publication passed. Full exact-head CI succeeded in 357 seconds;
  all nine status contexts are green, with statement-origin skipped by the
  normal area filter. CI's first admission read the old head immediately
  after push and refused; after GitHub confirmed the new head, the normal
  retry passed.
- The rooted blueprint axiom audit passed with no proof-level completeness
  claim depending on `sorryAx`; four existing statement-only warnings remain.
- Independent bounded recheck
  [5241678033](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/pull/456#pullrequestreview-5241678033)
  approved the correction and resolved both terminal findings. The four earlier
  full reviews and the adverse terminal review are retained.

---
Closes #452
